notes.title: Multiplayer Summon!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Summon players! 
After listening to your feedback, we decided to make a separate, cooperative version of Summon. 
The game is currently under active development, but you can already add it to the wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998970/_/


You can follow the development progress in our TG - [url=t.me/goosixgames]GoosixGames[/url]

notes.title: Bug fix 1
notes.notes:
- Fixed problems with text after turning off the lights of the VHS player and the electric lock.
- The valve in the basement is now easier to notice.
- Jumping on the bathroom sink is now easy.
- The location of the bills on the street has been slightly changed.
- Buildings on the street don't fly anymore.
- A hint for beginners has appeared in the menu.
